roadmap.title: Finish the story
roadmap.description: Complete the 16 main quests on any difficulty, opening nearby purple and Nornir Chests when convenient.

roadmap.title: Free-roam cleanup
roadmap.description: Use post-story free roam, region trackers, and the checklists to finish exploration, collectibles, Favors, crafting, and cumulative combat goals.

roadmap.title: Muspelheim, Niflheim, and Valkyries
roadmap.description: Clear the two optional realms, finish both weapon upgrades, defeat all nine Valkyries, and leave Queen Sigrun until the build is complete.

roadmap.title: Completion
roadmap.description: Confirm that every other Steam achievement has unlocked to receive Father and Son automatically.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks after every other achievement.
achievements.summary: Unlock all other @mechanic{36 Steam achievements} in the base game.

guide.context: No DLC, online mode, or difficulty-specific requirement is part of the completion set.

steps.text: Complete every other achievement in the 37-entry Steam list; Father and Son unlocks automatically when the final remaining entry registers.

achievements.description: Defend your home from The Stranger.
achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{The Marked Trees}, the first main quest, after defending Kratos’s home from @enemy{The Stranger}.

guide.context: This is a mandatory story event and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Finish the confrontation with The Stranger and continue to the end of The Marked Trees.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Survive the Witch’s Woods during @loc{Path to the Mountain}, the second main quest.

guide.context: The Witch’s Woods sequence is mandatory and has no difficulty requirement.

steps.text: Follow Path to the Mountain until Kratos and Atreus leave the Witch’s Woods safely.

achievements.description: Allow the Light Elves to return home.
achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Restore the Light Elves during @loc{The Light of Alfheim}, the fourth main quest.

guide.context: The realm’s story outcome is fixed and does not depend on a dialogue or route choice.

steps.text: Complete the mandatory Light of Alfheim objectives until the Light Elves return.

achievements.description: Defeat the Dragon of the Mountain.
achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Hraezlyr} during @loc{Inside the Mountain}, the fifth main quest.

guide.context: Hraezlyr is a required campaign boss and can be defeated on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish the Hraezlyr boss fight in Inside the Mountain and proceed until the achievement registers.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Magni and Modi} during @loc{The Magic Chisel}, the seventh main quest.

guide.context: The dual boss encounter lies on the mandatory story route.

steps.text: Complete the Magni and Modi boss fight during The Magic Chisel.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Retrieve the @item{Blades of Chaos} and defeat their first enemy wave during @loc{The Sickness}.

guide.context: The weapon retrieval occurs during the ninth main quest and cannot be skipped.

steps.text: Collect the Blades of Chaos, equip them as prompted, and defeat the first group of enemies with the restored weapon.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Heal @npc{Atreus} and complete @loc{The Sickness}, the ninth main quest.

guide.context: This unlock follows the Blades of Chaos retrieval and is awarded at quest completion.

steps.text: Finish every remaining objective in The Sickness until Atreus is healed.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Rescue @npc{Atreus} and complete @loc{Return to the Summit}, the eleventh main quest.

guide.context: The rescue is mandatory campaign progress with no optional outcome.

steps.text: Finish Return to the Summit after recovering Atreus.

achievements.description: Ride the ship out of Helheim.
achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Escape Helheim aboard the ship and complete @loc{Escape from Helheim}, the twelfth main quest.

guide.context: The achievement registers automatically at the end of this mandatory quest and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Complete the ship escape and reach the quest-ending transition outside Helheim.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Baldur} and complete @loc{Jötunheim in Reach}, the fifteenth main quest.

guide.context: Baldur is the mandatory final major boss before the journey to Jötunheim.

steps.text: Win the Baldur encounter and finish Jötunheim in Reach.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Spread the ashes in @loc{Jötunheim} and complete @loc{Mother’s Ashes}, the sixteenth main quest.

guide.context: Post-story free roam opens after this quest, allowing every remaining non-cipher location to be revisited.

steps.text: Reach the summit in Jötunheim, complete the ash-spreading sequence, and finish Mother’s Ashes.

achievements.description: Explore all the Lake of Nine has to offer.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: After the Lake of Nine’s second water-level drop, revisit all @loc{12 named regions} and enter each area until its discovery label appears.

guide.context: Cleared map fog does not prove that the post-drop visit registered, and some regions require more than one landing. After revisiting all 12 regions, use a Mystic Gateway if the exploration check needs to refresh.

collectibles.name: The Mason’s Channel
collectibles.method: Dock at either Mason’s Channel landing and move inland until the region label appears.

collectibles.name: Council of Valkyries
collectibles.method: Land at Alfheim Tower, clear the red sap with Atreus’s Shock Arrows, and climb into the throne-room region.

collectibles.name: Stone Falls
collectibles.method: Dock below Stone Falls and climb to the upper bridge and wayward-spirit area.

collectibles.name: Veithurgard
collectibles.method: Pull the gate chain atop Stone Falls, pass through the opened golden gate by boat, and enter Veithurgard.

collectibles.name: Buri’s Storeroom
collectibles.method: Dock on Buri’s Storeroom island and pass through its left-hand gate.

collectibles.name: Cliffs of the Raven
collectibles.method: Dock at the Cliffs of the Raven beach and advance to the rear lore-marker clearing.

collectibles.name: Lookout Tower
collectibles.method: Dock at Lookout Tower and climb beyond the retractable spike walls.

collectibles.name: Isle of Death
collectibles.method: Dock at Isle of Death and climb its central hill.

collectibles.name: Iron Cove
collectibles.method: Reach Iron Cove from Isle of Death’s right zipline or its boat landing and enter the cliff area.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Caverns
collectibles.method: Dock at Forgotten Caverns’ main beach and climb past the wayward spirit.

collectibles.name: Ruins of the Ancient
collectibles.method: Dock on the small Ruins of the Ancient island and step onto its central shore.

collectibles.name: Light Elf Outpost
collectibles.method: Dock at Light Elf Outpost and create the first light bridge into the island.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% in @loc{Veithurgard}. Its tracked objectives are 6 Artifacts, 3 Ravens, 6 Lore Markers, 1 Gateway, 1 Shop, 1 Legendary Chest, and 1 Nornir Chest.

guide.context: The Veithurgard Favor and Otr’s dragon release are not part of this region-completion trigger.

steps.text: Climb to the top of @loc{Stone Falls}, pull the chain that opens the Lake of Nine’s golden gate, and sail through that gate into Veithurgard.
Use Veithurgard’s map tracker while collecting all six Artifacts, the Mystic Gateway, Shop, six Lore Markers, Legendary Chest, Nornir Chest, and three Odin’s Ravens.
Open the Veithurgard map and confirm that every required category shows its full count; the achievement appears when the region exploration check completes.

achievements.description: Learn the languages of Muspelheim and Niflheim
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Open purple cipher chests until Atreus completes @item{4 Muspelheim ciphers} and @item{4 Niflheim ciphers}.

guide.context: Thirteen cipher chests exist, only eight are required, and the one-time Sea Serpent chest is therefore optional. Cipher chests are not tracked on regional maps.

steps.text: Open purple chests bearing a floating white face-lock by letting Atreus use his dagger.
Continue opening cipher chests until the Muspelheim language reaches four pieces and Muspelheim unlocks in the Realm Travel Room.
Continue opening cipher chests until the Niflheim language reaches four pieces and Niflheim unlocks; the achievement registers once both four-piece languages are complete.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: At a Brok or Sindri shop, upgrade one equipped armor piece through the @mechanic{Upgrade} menu.

guide.context: Low-tier armor is the cheapest route and can cost about 1,000 Hacksilver.

steps.text: Craft or obtain an armor piece, then equip that piece on Kratos.
Visit Brok or Sindri, open @mechanic{Upgrade}, select the equipped armor piece, and hold the displayed confirmation input until the upgrade completes.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Open the mandatory chest that Atreus identifies during @loc{Path to the Mountain} to obtain the first Runic Attack Gem.

guide.context: Runic Attack Gems also come from later chests, Favors, and difficult enemies, but the campaign supplies this first one automatically.

steps.text: Follow Path to the Mountain until Atreus points out the required chest, then open it and collect the Runic Attack Gem.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Collect @item{9 Iðunn Apples} from Nornir Chests; every third Apple automatically increases health, and the ninth Apple completes all three upgrades.

guide.context: Every three Apples grants one health increase. The 21 available Nornir Chests provide enough Apples and Horns for both upgrade achievements.

steps.text: Open the Wildwoods chest behind the barricade at the four-way stone structure by destroying its three room seals.
Open all five River Pass chests: the bridge seals below Brok; the ceiling-spike trap seals; the troll-arena bells; the Witch’s Cave seals; and the late green-energy rune puzzle outside the cave.
Set the Foothills posts to E, P, and a left-facing B, freezing the poison vent to expose the final post.
Open both Mountain chests by matching the torch-revealed glyph posts, then breaking the three Summit-route seals around the Ymir room and bridge.
Strike the three timed bells surrounding the Nornir Chest in Fafnir’s Storeroom.
Use Winds of Hel at Konunsgard’s upper wall, expose the N rune, and hit C, R, and N before the timer expires.
Move Winds of Hel among the three Cliffs of the Raven rune holders and remove the energy as each holder displays the chest’s required rune.
At Lookout Tower, retract the chest’s spikes with the overhead board and quickly strike all three exposed rune targets.
Below the Forgotten Caverns raven, use quick axe throws to ring the three bells left of the chest.
At Light Elf Outpost, reveal the seals on the lake pillar, at the carried-crystal socket, and above the chain beside the return gate.
Break Veithurgard’s seals beside the chest, atop the stone circle from the shrine, and in the tunnel behind the chest.
Break Tyr’s Temple’s seals beneath the wall-spike trap, in the preceding circular room, and atop the falling ceiling-spike block.

Open Alfheim’s four chests by solving the right-island sound targets, the underground platform seals, the three timed runes opposite Sindri, and the left-center-right bells beyond Freya’s Temple light bridge.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Collect @item{9 Horns of Blood Mead} from Nornir Chests; every third Horn automatically increases rage, and the ninth Horn completes all three upgrades.

guide.context: Every three Horns grants one rage increase. Continue through the 21-chest route until both the ninth Horn and ninth Apple have appeared.

steps.text: Open the Wildwoods chest behind the barricade at the four-way stone structure by destroying its three room seals.
Open all five River Pass chests: the bridge seals below Brok; the ceiling-spike trap seals; the troll-arena bells; the Witch’s Cave seals; and the late green-energy rune puzzle outside the cave.
Set the Foothills posts to E, P, and a left-facing B, freezing the poison vent to expose the final post.
Open both Mountain chests by matching the torch-revealed glyph posts, then breaking the three Summit-route seals around the Ymir room and bridge.
Strike the three timed bells surrounding the Nornir Chest in Fafnir’s Storeroom.
Use Winds of Hel at Konunsgard’s upper wall, expose the N rune, and hit C, R, and N before the timer expires.
Move Winds of Hel among the three Cliffs of the Raven rune holders and remove the energy as each holder displays the chest’s required rune.
At Lookout Tower, retract the chest’s spikes with the overhead board and quickly strike all three exposed rune targets.
Below the Forgotten Caverns raven, use quick axe throws to ring the three bells left of the chest.
At Light Elf Outpost, reveal the seals on the lake pillar, at the carried-crystal socket, and above the chain beside the return gate.
Break Veithurgard’s seals beside the chest, atop the stone circle from the shrine, and in the tunnel behind the chest.
Break Tyr’s Temple’s seals beneath the wall-spike trap, in the preceding circular room, and atop the falling ceiling-spike block.

Open Alfheim’s four chests by solving the right-island sound targets, the underground platform seals, the three timed runes opposite Sindri, and the left-center-right bells beyond Freya’s Temple light bridge.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Buy any @item{Atreus Armor} outfit from the crafting menu at a Brok or Sindri shop.

guide.context: The least expensive Atreus outfit costs 10,000 Hacksilver.

steps.text: Visit Brok or Sindri, open the crafting menu, and select @item{Atreus Armor}.
Purchase any displayed Atreus outfit and wait for the crafting completion to register the achievement.

achievements.description: Slot an Enchantment into your armor
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Place an enchantment into an empty socket on one upgraded or high-tier armor piece.

guide.context: Bosses and blacksmith shops provide enchantments, while upgrading ordinary armor creates the required socket.

steps.text: Upgrade an armor piece or craft high-tier armor that already contains an enchantment socket.
Collect an enchantment from a boss drop or buy one from Brok or Sindri after enough story progress.
Open the character menu, select @mechanic{Armor}, inspect the socketed piece, and place the enchantment into its empty slot.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Defeat a cumulative total of @enemy{1,000 enemies} across the campaign, Favors, exploration, and optional realms.

guide.context: Normal 100% completion supplies more than enough enemies, so dedicated farming is usually unnecessary.

steps.text: Complete the story, Favors, collectible encounters, Muspelheim trials, Niflheim runs, and Valkyries while defeating every hostile group encountered.
If the achievement remains locked near the end, enter a Muspelheim Trial, choose @mechanic{Warmup}, and defeat respawning waves until the cumulative total reaches 1,000.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Free @npc{Fafnir}, @npc{Otr}, and @npc{Reginn} by destroying each dragon’s three binding shrines and releasing the final lock.

guide.context: Each dragon is tracked as a regional Favor: Fafnir at Council of Valkyries, Otr in Veithurgard, and Reginn in Konunsgard.

steps.text: At the Council of Valkyries dragon area, destroy Fafnir’s shrines on the far-left lore side, beneath the dragon on the left, and above the right-side waterfall wall; return to the front platform and release Fafnir.
In Veithurgard, destroy Otr’s shrines up the right hill, on the center path, and beyond the broken bridge through the four-rune gate; return to Otr’s platform and release the dragon.

In Konunsgard, destroy Reginn’s shrines beyond the explosive-sealed upper gate, directly before the dragon, and inside the tunnel left of the dragon; return to the binding platform and release Reginn.

achievements.description: Complete all of Brok and Sindri’s Favors
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Complete @mechanic{Second Hand Soul} and @mechanic{Deus Ex Malachite} for Brok, then finish Sindri’s @mechanic{Fafnir’s Hoard} and @mechanic{Family Business}. Complete their joint Favor, @mechanic{Hail to the King}, last.

guide.context: The quests unlock gradually at blacksmith shops; Niflheim jobs are outside this five-Favor requirement.

steps.text: Accept Brok’s @mechanic{Second Hand Soul} at a shop, complete the Volunder Mines objectives, and report back.
After Brok offers @mechanic{Deus Ex Malachite}, complete its Landsuther Mines objectives and report back.
Accept Sindri’s @mechanic{Fafnir’s Hoard}, complete the storeroom objectives, and report back.
After Sindri offers @mechanic{Family Business}, complete the Northri Stronghold objectives and report back.
Meet Brok and Sindri together at Tyr’s Temple, accept @mechanic{Hail to the King}, and finish the Konunsgard quest.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{45 Artifacts} across Midgard, Alfheim, and Helheim.

guide.context: Artifacts shimmer on the ground, regional map trackers show remaining counts, and selling collected pieces never removes achievement credit.

collectibles.name: Wildwoods — 4 Artifacts
collectibles.method: Collect the pieces before Kratos’s house Gateway, before the right-hand stone stairs, below the chain at the four-way circle, and outside beneath the fort bridge.

collectibles.name: The River Pass — 9 Artifacts
collectibles.method: Collect the pieces below the Gateway chain, right of Brok, beyond and outside the ceiling-spike trap, beyond the disc puzzle, behind a burned hut, on Witch’s Cave center platform, downhill toward the turtle, and beside the upper Nornir Chest.

collectibles.name: The Mountain — 6 Artifacts
collectibles.method: Collect the pieces behind the first wooden wall, behind the axe-operated spike door, beyond ground-level red sap, on the snowy descent, below the red crystal after the dark corridor, and beyond the Summit shop’s wall squeeze.

collectibles.name: Cliffs of the Raven — 1 Artifact
collectibles.method: Climb Atreus’s dropped chain and take the Artifact beside the purple cipher chest.

collectibles.name: Lookout Tower — 1 Artifact
collectibles.method: Reach the upper Nornir Chest, retract the floor spikes with the overhead board, and take the Artifact beside the trapped corpse.

collectibles.name: Isle of Death — 1 Artifact
collectibles.method: Climb the central hill and explode the yellow rocks to expose the corpse holding the Artifact.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Caverns — 1 Artifact
collectibles.method: Climb from the main beach and take the Artifact beside the purple cipher chest.

collectibles.name: Stone Falls — 1 Artifact
collectibles.method: Pass through the upper right gate, climb the side path, and search the corpse.

collectibles.name: Veithurgard — 6 Artifacts
collectibles.method: Collect the pieces below the frozen-chain ledge, on the boat bridge, behind crates left of Otr, on the broken bridge, left of Skadi’s shrine, and beside the corpse after draining the water.

collectibles.name: Shores of Nine — 4 Artifacts
collectibles.method: Collect the piece on Tyr’s Temple’s left dock path and the three pieces atop Niflheim Tower, Helheim Tower, and Alfheim Tower.

collectibles.name: Alfheim — 6 Artifacts
collectibles.method: Collect the pieces behind three aligned growth nodes, on the right beach, in the wheel-accessed lower room, in the right room beyond the light bridge, left of the crystal elevator, and at the later dead end.

collectibles.name: Helheim — 5 Artifacts
collectibles.method: Collect the pieces outside the Realm Travel room, in vines below the bridge, in vines behind the story-path pillar, right of the Hidden Chamber entrance, and behind the torch above its lower stairs.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Destroy all @enemy{51 tracked Odin’s Ravens} across Midgard, Alfheim, and Helheim.

guide.context: Ravens are green and usually emit a metallic call; each regional tracker shows how many tracked birds remain.

collectibles.name: Wildwoods — 1 Raven
collectibles.method: Destroy the raven circling over the red tree in the Hidden Chamber’s Realm Tear room.

collectibles.name: The River Pass — 6 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy the ravens beside the Gateway, at the lit cave collapse, on a curved troll-arena bone, on the first burned hut, high in the Valkyrie room, and beside the broken signpost near the final Artifact.

collectibles.name: Foothills — 2 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy the raven above the Hidden Chamber Gateway and the raven atop the cable-car station.

collectibles.name: The Mountain — 4 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy the ravens under the skeleton bridge, circling Brok’s shop, on the upper path beyond the chain/cart, and inside the Valkyrie room.

collectibles.name: Volunder Mines — 1 Raven
collectibles.method: After landing, ride the beach elevator and destroy the raven circling above it.

collectibles.name: Landsuther Mines — 2 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy the raven above the Gateway and Brok’s shop, then the raven on the high rock outside the final room after Deus Ex Malachite.

collectibles.name: Fafnir’s Storeroom — 5 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy the ravens above the beach elevator, circling Sindri, on the left woods branch, atop the huge stone entrance, and circling the central corpse platform.

collectibles.name: Northri Stronghold — 2 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy the raven overlooking the entrance water behind Sindri and the raven on the metal grid across from the wrecked boat after Family Business.

collectibles.name: Konunsgard — 5 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy the ravens facing the red chest on Sindri’s left path, on the distant rock from the right-key pillar, beneath Reginn, beside the third-shrine path, and high beyond the Starkadr shrine.

collectibles.name: Cliffs of the Raven — 1 Raven
collectibles.method: From the cipher/artifact ledge, aim above the beach toward the distant mountain peak and destroy the raven.

collectibles.name: Lookout Tower — 1 Raven
collectibles.method: After two wall climbs, destroy the raven circling above the upper Nornir Chest.

collectibles.name: Isle of Death — 1 Raven
collectibles.method: From the landing beach, look to the left and destroy the raven.

collectibles.name: Iron Cove — 1 Raven
collectibles.method: Clear the explosive rocks and poison around the old ship, climb aboard, and destroy the distant raven circling beyond the cliffs.

collectibles.name: Forgotten Caverns — 2 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy the raven above the main-beach Nornir Chest and the raven atop the climb at the left landing inside the Konunsgard sea tunnel.

collectibles.name: Buri’s Storeroom — 1 Raven
collectibles.method: Pass through the island’s left gate and destroy the distant raven circling the tall rock.

collectibles.name: Stone Falls — 1 Raven
collectibles.method: At the upper wayward spirit, lower the bridge and destroy the raven perched on the cliff above it.

collectibles.name: Veithurgard — 3 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy the ravens circling Thor’s statue island, behind planks beneath Otr, and left of the four-rune gate.

collectibles.name: Thamur’s Corpse — 2 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy the distant raven on the wall above the first Gateway and the raven on the red tree in the lower Valkyrie room.

collectibles.name: Shores of Nine — 1 Raven
collectibles.method: From the top of Niflheim Tower, destroy the raven perched on the shipwreck below.

collectibles.name: Council of Valkyries — 1 Raven
collectibles.method: Land at Alfheim Tower, remove the red sap, climb the wall, and destroy the raven atop the large brown statue.

collectibles.name: Alfheim — 2 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy one raven perched on the blue-light statue on the lake’s far-left island. Find the other along the left wall inside the Hidden Chamber’s Valkyrie room.

collectibles.name: Helheim — 6 Ravens
collectibles.method: Destroy the ravens on the ring above the first Legendary Chest, behind sap beyond the ice crawlspace, circling the lower abyss, on the ice above it, inside the Hidden Chamber entrance, and above its lower Gateway.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Buy both XP upgrades for one slotted Runic Attack to raise that attack to level 3.

guide.context: The early @item{Hel’s Touch} Runic Attack costs only 5,000 XP for both upgrades, making it the cheapest recommended choice.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Weapons} and place a Runic Attack Gem into a matching empty weapon slot.
Inspect that slotted rune and purchase its first and second XP upgrades until the attack displays level 3.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: After the story, trade @item{Chilling Mist of Niflheim} for the final Frozen Flame and upgrade the Leviathan Axe to level 6.

guide.context: Mandatory bosses provide the first Frozen Flames, and missed drops move to the Lost Items tab at blacksmith shops.

steps.text: Finish the story, retrieve every Frozen Flame from bosses or @mechanic{Lost Items}, and buy the Leviathan Axe upgrades through level 5.
Unlock Niflheim, earn 5,000 Mist Echoes, and open the center-chamber chest containing @item{Chilling Mist of Niflheim}.
At a blacksmith shop, open @mechanic{Buy} > @mechanic{Resources} and trade Chilling Mist of Niflheim for a Frozen Flame.
Use that Frozen Flame at the shop to purchase the Leviathan Axe’s level 6 upgrade.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade the Blades of Chaos.
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: After finishing the story, exchange @item{Raging Inferno of Muspelheim} for a Chaos Flame and use it to bring the Blades of Chaos to their fifth upgrade level.

guide.context: Mandatory bosses provide the earlier Chaos Flames, while the final material comes from Muspelheim’s summit Valkyrie.

steps.text: Retrieve the Blades of Chaos, collect boss Chaos Flames or recover them from @mechanic{Lost Items}, and buy upgrades through level 4.
Unlock Muspelheim, clear the first five trial sites, and defeat the summit Valkyrie to obtain @item{Raging Inferno of Muspelheim}.
At a blacksmith shop, open @mechanic{Buy} > @mechanic{Resources} and trade Raging Inferno of Muspelheim for a Chaos Flame.
Use that Chaos Flame at the shop to purchase the Blades of Chaos level 5 upgrade.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Craft the Traveler chest, wrist, and waist armor using @item{8 Traveller’s Armour Shards} and @item{30 Traveller’s Grisly Trophies}.

guide.context: Four or five Travelers normally provide enough materials, and missed drops appear under Lost Items at any blacksmith.

steps.text: Defeat a Traveler, collect its Armour Shard, and deliver that shard to Brok or Sindri to unlock @mechanic{The Road Less Travelled} crafting labour.
Defeat Travelers until the inventory contains 8 Traveller’s Armour Shards and 30 Traveller’s Grisly Trophies.
At a blacksmith, craft all three Traveler set pieces: chest, wrist, and waist.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Craft the Ancient chest, wrist, and waist armor using @item{3 Ancient’s Hearts} and @item{16 Ancient Rubble}.

guide.context: Three or four Ancients normally supply the materials; reliable encounters occur in story quests, Favors, Wildwoods Edge, Ruins of the Ancient, and Veithurgard.

steps.text: Defeat an Ancient, collect its Heart, and deliver that Heart to Brok or Sindri to unlock @mechanic{Hearts of Stone}.
Defeat Ancients until the inventory contains 3 Ancient’s Hearts and 16 Ancient Rubble.
At a blacksmith, craft all three Ancient set pieces: chest, wrist, and waist.

achievements.description: Assist all of the wayward spirits
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Complete the five Midgard wayward-spirit Favors: Dead Freight, Hammer Fall, The Anatomy of Hope, Unfinished Business, and Time Heals All.

guide.context: Four quests begin from spirits or lore stones around the Lake of Nine; Time Heals All begins from a hidden scroll in Northri Stronghold.

steps.text: At Forgotten Caverns’ southern dock, accept @mechanic{Dead Freight}, defeat all four waypoint-marked crew groups, and return to the spirit.
Atop Stone Falls, accept @mechanic{Hammer Fall}, destroy Thor’s statue in Veithurgard, and return to the spirit.
At Mason’s Channel’s northern dock, accept @mechanic{The Anatomy of Hope}, collect the three waypoint-marked bones, and return to the spirit.
Visit all four marked lore stones. One is in Cliffs of the Raven, one is on Isle of Death, one is in Iron Cove, and one is in Forgotten Caverns. Activate each stone and win its enemy encounter.
During or after Family Business, reach the far end of Northri Stronghold and take the lore scroll. Bring it back to the spirit in Fafnir’s Storeroom.

achievements.description: Use treasure maps to find all of the dig spots
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{12 Treasure Maps} and excavate each map’s matching dig spot.

guide.context: Dig spots remain invisible until their matching map has been collected; every pair remains available in post-story free roam.

collectibles.name: The Turtle’s Tribute
collectibles.method: Collect the map behind Shock-Arrow sap before the Witch’s Cave Hidden Chamber, then climb the well and dig by the stones facing the turtle house.

collectibles.name: Dead and Bloated
collectibles.method: Collect the map beside the red chest on the Second Hand Soul route, then dig between the dead giant’s arm and leg at Cliffs of the Raven.

collectibles.name: Kneel Before Thor!
collectibles.method: Take the map beside the basement elevator’s hidden red chest, then zipline to Muspelheim Tower and dig right of its Jötnar Shrine.

collectibles.name: Don’t Blink
collectibles.method: Take the map beside the central-chamber corpse, then dig beneath the carved stone face’s nose at the Foothills mountain entrance.

collectibles.name: Njörd’s Oarsmen
collectibles.method: Take the map from the wrecked boat, then climb from Mason’s Channel’s southern dock and dig before the two giant statues.

collectibles.name: Creation Island
collectibles.method: Take the map from Iron Cove’s southern beach, then dig behind Buri’s Storeroom in the sand facing Veithurgard’s golden gate.

collectibles.name: Finder’s Fee
collectibles.method: Take the map beside Forgotten Caverns’ southern Gateway, then climb the tower by Northri Stronghold’s water wheel and dig beside the corpse.

collectibles.name: The Boat Captain’s Key
collectibles.method: Take the map across the axe-lowered bridge atop Stone Falls, then climb Isle of Death and dig below the old ship.

collectibles.name: Island of Light
collectibles.method: Take the map from the sand at Mason’s Channel’s southern dock, then progress through Light Elf Outpost and dig beyond the return gate after the Nornir Chest.

collectibles.name: The Historian
collectibles.method: Take the map from the Ruins of the Ancient sand, then dig left of Fafnir’s Storeroom’s huge entrance beside the fire.

collectibles.name: Hunter’s Kingdom
collectibles.method: Take the map before Lookout Tower’s upper Nornir Chest, then dig before the lore marker left of Veithurgard’s four-rune gate.

collectibles.name: The Last Place They’d Look
collectibles.method: Take the map from the hidden Summit passage beyond Sindri’s shop, then dig in the Council of Valkyries throne room beside its Gateway.

achievements.description: Read all of the Jötnar shrines
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Open all @item{11 Jötnar Shrines} and let Atreus read every shrine.

guide.context: Jötnar Shrines resemble large wooden doors and do not appear in regional collectible trackers.

collectibles.name: Sköll and Hati
collectibles.method: Open the wooden shrine in the fort’s upper tunnel after using the chain gate and climbing left.

collectibles.name: Hrungnir
collectibles.method: Open the shrine at the rear of the area above the bridge Nornir Chest.

collectibles.name: Ymir
collectibles.method: On the late Summit route, destroy the red sap with a thrown crystal and Shock Arrows, then open the hidden shrine.

collectibles.name: Starkadr
collectibles.method: Use both keys on the central door, take the right-hand path, and open the shrine.

collectibles.name: Skadi
collectibles.method: Set the four-rune gate to T, R, N, and F, pass through it, and open the shrine directly ahead.

collectibles.name: Bergelmir
collectibles.method: Reach the temple’s second section, descend the common elevator, and open the shrine behind it.

collectibles.name: Thamur
collectibles.method: Enter the Hidden Chamber and open the shrine on its top floor.

collectibles.name: Jörmungadr
collectibles.method: Enter Vanaheim Tower between the Lake of Nine and Foothills and open the shrine inside.

collectibles.name: Thrym
collectibles.method: Ride Lookout Tower’s zipline toward Muspelheim Tower and open the shrine on the path.

collectibles.name: Groa
collectibles.method: Return to Alfheim’s central light structure and open the shrine beside Sindri’s shop.

collectibles.name: Surtr
collectibles.method: Before Trial 1, open the shrine left of the first outdoor Mystic Gateway beside Brok’s shop.

achievements.description: Complete all of the Trials of Muspelheim
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Clear Muspelheim Trials 1–5 on Normal and Hard, defeat the summit Valkyrie, earn 3 Impossible keys, and finish Trial 6.

guide.context: Only three of the five Impossible trials are needed; Trials 2, 3, and 5 are the recommended easier key sources, and game difficulty may be lowered.

steps.text: Collect four Muspelheim ciphers and select Muspelheim in the Realm Travel Room.
At each of Trial sites 1–5, finish the Normal challenge and then its Hard challenge to open the route to the summit.
Defeat the Valkyrie at the summit to activate Impossible challenges.
Complete any three Impossible trials to receive three keys; Trials 2, 3, and 5 are the recommended set.
Spend the three keys to start Trial 6, then defeat 50 enemies within 8 minutes.

achievements.description: Retrieve all treasure from the Workshop’s center chamber
achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: In Niflheim, spend @item{68,500 Mist Echoes} and @item{3 Anchors of Fog} to open all 5 center-chamber chests and close all 3 Realm Tears.

guide.context: Mist Echoes and resources save only when Kratos leaves the Mist alive; dying restores the pre-run inventory.

steps.text: Collect four Niflheim ciphers, travel to Niflheim, and complete Sindri’s opening Ivaldi’s Workshop Favor to access the center chamber.

Run complete labyrinth loops, defeat each room, open every chest, and return to Sindri alive; sell Niflheim materials through @mechanic{Sell} > @mechanic{Resources} until 68,500 Mist Echoes are available.
Open golden chests in deep dead-end combat rooms until three @item{Anchors of Fog} have been collected.
Open all five treasure chests and spend one Anchor of Fog at each of the three Realm Tears, defeating every Tear encounter.

achievements.sortReason: Complete during the recommended cleanup phase.
achievements.summary: Defeat the 8 regional Valkyries, place their helmets on the @loc{Council of Valkyries’ red thrones}, activate the center Realm Tear to summon @enemy{Sigrun, the Valkyrie Queen}, and defeat Sigrun.

guide.context: The four Midgard Valkyries occupy Hidden Chambers; the others are in Alfheim, Helheim, Muspelheim, and Niflheim. Sigrun is best saved until both weapons and Runic Attacks are upgraded.

steps.text: Defeat the Valkyries inside the Hidden Chambers at The River Pass, Foothills, The Mountain, and Thamur’s Corpse.
Defeat the Valkyrie in Alfheim’s Hidden Chamber.
Defeat the Valkyrie in the final room of Helheim’s Hidden Chamber.
Clear Muspelheim Trials 1–5 and defeat the Valkyrie at the summit.
Enter Niflheim’s Mist Labyrinth, reach the leftmost quadrant shown on its map, and defeat the Valkyrie there.
Take all eight helmets to the Council of Valkyries, place one on each red throne, and activate the Realm Tear in the center.
Dodge Sigrun’s red-indicator unblockable attacks, use fully upgraded Runic Attacks during safe openings, and defeat her to register the ninth Valkyrie.
